SepaMandate.title: SEPA Mandate
SepaMandate.description: A SEPA Direct Debit mandate (incassomachtiging) authorising the creditor to collect from a debtor account under the SDD CORE or B2B rulebook (REQ-SDD-001). Source of truth for incasso eligibility; collections may only be scheduled against an `active` mandate (design D1).

mandateReference.description: Unique mandate reference per creditor, max 35 chars, immutable once issued (REQ-SDD-001). Operator-supplied; never auto-generated.

creditorIdentifier.description: Dutch creditor identifier NL{check}ZZZ{KvK} per De Nederlandsche Bank (REQ-SDD-001).

scheme.description: SDD rulebook scheme: CORE (consumer debtors) or B2B (business debtors) (REQ-SDD-001).

type.description: recurring (RCUR-capable) or oneoff (OOFF, single collection only) (REQ-SDD-002).

status.description: Mandate lifecycle status (REQ-SDD-001, REQ-SDD-008). Managed by x-openregister-lifecycle.

signedAt.description: Date the mandate was signed by the debtor (REQ-SDD-001). Must not be after a collection's requestedCollectionDate (REQ-SDD-005).

signedBy.description: Debtor name as it appears on the mandate document (REQ-SDD-001).

debtorIban.description: Debtor bank account IBAN; validated mod-97 at batch generation (REQ-SDD-005).

debtorBic.description: BIC/SWIFT; mandatory for non-EEA destinations, optional for EEA (REQ-SDD-001).

debtorAccountType.description: consumer (CORE only) or business (B2B only). Mismatch with scheme is rejected sdd.mandate.scheme.mismatch (REQ-SDD-001).

lastCollectionDate.description: Last known or planned collection date (REQ-SDD-001).

lastUsedAt.description: Date of last successful collection; drives the 36-month dormancy expiry rule (REQ-SDD-008).

mandateDocument.description: OpenRegister file reference to the scanned signature or digital-signing evidence (PDF/image) (REQ-SDD-001). Stored per OR files-attached-to-object pattern.

cancellationReason.description: Free-text reason recorded when status transitions to cancelled (REQ-SDD-008).

preNotificationDays.description: Lead time in calendar days for pre-notification; default 14 per SDD CORE rulebook 2.6, configurable down to contractual minimum (REQ-SDD-003).

reviewFlag.description: Set true when a consumer refund (MD06) is received; high refund rate risks scheme exclusion (REQ-SDD-007).

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (tenant scope; REQ-SDD-001).

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: Awaiting signature/activation. No collections may be scheduled (design D1).

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: Terminal. No further collections may reference this mandate (REQ-SDD-008). cancellationReason recorded.

expired.label: Expired
expired.description: Terminal. Auto-set after 36 months of inactivity (REQ-SDD-008). Requires a fresh mandate.

activate.label: Activate mandate
activate.description: Operator activates a signed mandate, making it eligible for collections (REQ-SDD-001).

cancel.label: Cancel mandate
cancel.description: Operator cancels the mandate with a recorded cancellationReason. Future-dated scheduled collections are cancelled automatically (REQ-SDD-008).

suspend.label: Suspend mandate
suspend.description: Temporarily block the mandate from new collections (REQ-SDD-001).

resume.label: Resume mandate
resume.description: Re-enable a suspended mandate for collections (REQ-SDD-001).

expire.label: Expire (dormancy)
expire.description: Automated transition after 36 months of inactivity, driven by the daily MandateDormancyExpiryJob (REQ-SDD-008).

DirectDebitCollection.title: Direct Debit Collection
DirectDebitCollection.description: A single SEPA Direct Debit collection against a mandate (REQ-SDD-002). sequenceType is derived from mandate history, never operator-supplied (design D2).

invoiceId.description: FK to Invoice UUID (nullable for ad-hoc collections) (REQ-SDD-002).

amount.description: Collection amount in EUR, two decimals (REQ-SDD-002).

sequenceType.description: Auto-derived from mandate history; operator input is rejected (REQ-SDD-002, design D2). FRST=first, RCUR=recurrent, OOFF=one-off, FNAL=final.

requestedCollectionDate.description: Date funds should hit the creditor account (REQ-SDD-002).

endToEndId.description: Unique end-to-end identifier per creditor, max 35 chars (REQ-SDD-002).

pain002ReasonCode.description: ISO 20022 reason code if rejected, e.g. AM04, AC04, MD01 (REQ-SDD-006).

camt054ReferenceId.description: Reference ID from the camt.054 notification that closed this collection (REQ-SDD-007).

repostedAsCollectionId.description: FK to the new collection created when this one was reposted (REQ-SDD-009).

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (tenant scope; REQ-SDD-002).

scheduled.label: Scheduled
scheduled.description: Created and awaiting inclusion in a pain.008 batch (REQ-SDD-002).

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Included in a batch submitted to the bank (REQ-SDD-005).

presented.label: Presented
presented.description: Presented for debit at the debtor bank (REQ-SDD-002).

succeeded.label: Succeeded
succeeded.description: camt.054 debit confirmed; invoice paid, journal posted (REQ-SDD-007).

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: pain.002 RJCT with a reason code (REQ-SDD-006). Repostable only for bank-problem codes (REQ-SDD-009).

refunded.label: Refunded
refunded.description: camt.054 return/refund; journal reversed, receivable re-opened (REQ-SDD-007).

submit.label: Submit in batch
submit.description: Batch generation includes this collection; gated by pre-notification and submission-window guards (REQ-SDD-003, REQ-SDD-004).

reject.label: Rejected (pain.002)
reject.description: pain.002 RJCT ingestion with reason code (REQ-SDD-006).

refund.label: Refunded (camt.054 R-transaction)
refund.description: camt.054 return/refund; creates an RTransaction record (REQ-SDD-007).

repost.label: Repost
repost.description: One-click repost; allowed only for bank-problem reason codes (REQ-SDD-009).

batch.description: The batch this collection was submitted in (REQ-SDD-005).

DirectDebitBatch.title: Direct Debit Batch
DirectDebitBatch.description: A pain.008.001.02 batch aggregating homo-sequence collections for submission (REQ-SDD-005). pain008Xml / pain002Xml are archived 7+ years (bewaarplicht, design D11).

messageId.description: Globally unique message id per creditor per file, max 35 chars (REQ-SDD-005).

requestedCollectionDate.description: Earliest collection date in the batch (REQ-SDD-005).

collectionCount.description: Number of collections in the batch; equals pain.008 NbOfTxs (REQ-SDD-005).

controlSum.description: Sum of all collection amounts in EUR; equals pain.008 CtrlSum (REQ-SDD-005).

pain008Xml.description: Full ISO 20022 pain.008.001.02 payload; archived 7+ years, non-deletable (REQ-SDD-005, REQ-SDD-010).

pain002Xml.description: Incoming pain.002 status report; archived (REQ-SDD-006, REQ-SDD-010).

submittedAt.description: When the batch was submitted to the bank via connector (REQ-SDD-005).

isArchived.description: Retention flag; archived pain files must not be auto-deleted (REQ-SDD-010, design D11).

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (tenant scope; REQ-SDD-005).

generated.label: Generated
generated.description: pain.008 generated and XSD-validated; eligible for submission (REQ-SDD-005).

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Sent to the bank via connector (REQ-SDD-005).

fully_rejected.label: Fully rejected
fully_rejected.description: pain.002 RJCT for the whole group (REQ-SDD-006).

generate.label: Generate pain.008
generate.description: Generate and XSD-validate the pain.008 payload; gated by pre-notification and submission-window preconditions (REQ-SDD-003, REQ-SDD-004, REQ-SDD-005).

submit.label: Submit to bank
submit.description: Hand the batch to the bank connector (REQ-SDD-005).

RTransaction.title: R-Transaction
RTransaction.description: A bank-side R-transaction (reject/return/refund/reversal/revocation) parsed from pain.002 or camt.054 (REQ-SDD-007). Captured separately for audit and reposting decisions (design D7). Non-deletable (REQ-SDD-010).

reasonCode.description: ISO 20022 ExternalReturnReason code, e.g. MS03, AC04, MD01 (REQ-SDD-007).

originatorBic.description: BIC of the institution initiating the R-transaction (REQ-SDD-007).

transactionAmount.description: Amount of the R-transaction, usually matching the collection amount (REQ-SDD-007).

valueDate.description: Date the debtor account was re-credited (REQ-SDD-007).

notifiedAt.description: When shillinq received the R-transaction notification (REQ-SDD-007).

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (tenant scope; REQ-SDD-007).

PreNotification.title: Pre-notification
PreNotification.description: A vooraankondiging for a collection (REQ-SDD-003). A collection MUST NOT enter a pain.008 batch unless its pre-notification is sent or carried on the invoice line (design D3).

sentAt.description: When the notification was actually sent; null = not yet sent (REQ-SDD-003).

noticeDays.description: Calendar days between notification and collection date; default 14 (REQ-SDD-003).

recipientAddress.description: Email, postal address, or invoice reference per channel (REQ-SDD-003).

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration (tenant scope; REQ-SDD-003).

CustomerMaster.description: Customer master overlay adding the default SEPA mandate link (REQ-SDD-002). When a customer has a `defaultMandateId`, the AR billing flow proposes direct-debit collection by default; the field is OPTIONAL — collections may still be scheduled against any mandate the customer holds. Owning fragment: `add-shillinq-bookkeeping-compliance.json` (shillinq CustomerMaster is the AR-core analogue of the company-wide `Counterparty` entity referenced in design D1).

defaultMandateId.description: FK to the customer's default SEPA mandate UUID; when set the AR billing flow proposes direct-debit collection by default (REQ-SDD-002). Optional — collections may still be scheduled against any active mandate held by the customer. Cleared automatically when the referenced mandate transitions to `cancelled` or `expired`.

defaultMandate.description: The customer's default mandate for direct-debit collection (REQ-SDD-002).

ARInvoice.description: AR invoice overlay adding direct-debit payment-method linkage (REQ-SDD-002, REQ-SDD-003). When `paymentMethod = direct_debit`, `directDebitMandateId` MUST reference an `active` SepaMandate; the optional `directDebitPreNotificationInvoiceId` links back to the invoice whose line item carried the SEPA pre-notification (design D3 / REQ-SDD-003 invoice-line pre-notification channel). Owning fragment: `add-shillinq-bookkeeping-compliance.json`.

paymentMethod.description: Expected payment method (REQ-SDD-002). When `direct_debit`, `directDebitMandateId` MUST be populated and reference an `active` SepaMandate; collection scheduling is gated on this combination.

directDebitMandateId.description: FK to the SepaMandate UUID under which this invoice is to be collected (REQ-SDD-002). Required when `paymentMethod = direct_debit`; ignored otherwise. The mandate MUST be `active` at collection-scheduling time; cancellation or expiry triggers `sdd.mandate.cancelled` / `sdd.mandate.expired`.

directDebitPreNotificationInvoiceId.description: Optional FK to the ARInvoice whose line item carried the SEPA pre-notification text for this collection (REQ-SDD-003, design D3 invoice-line channel). When set, this invoice's pre-notification proof is sourced from the linked invoice's issue date + line text; the `PreNotification` register entry references the same invoice via `recipientAddress`.

directDebitMandate.description: The SEPA mandate authorising direct-debit collection of this invoice (REQ-SDD-002).

directDebitPreNotificationInvoice.description: The invoice whose line item carried the SEPA pre-notification text for this collection (REQ-SDD-003, design D3).
